title: Mexican Aubergine Quesadillas
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Mexican-inspired dish featuring crispy aubergine and melted cheese, wrapped inside a crunchy quesadilla.
instructions: 1. Preheat a large pan over medium-high heat.
2. Slice the aubergine into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
3. Brush both sides of the aubergine slices with olive oil.
4. Place the aubergine slices in the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until crispy.
5. Meanwhile, warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
6. To assemble the quesadillas, lay a tortilla flat and sprinkle shredded cheese on half of the tortilla.
7. Add a few slices of crispy aubergine on top of the cheese.
8. Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
9. Cook the quesadilla in the pan for 2-3 minutes on each side, until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is crispy.
10. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling ingredients.
